correctness.rationale: Centering annihilates exactly the zero mode. Direct integration of the positive eigenmodes gives the cross kernel λμ/(λ+μ)², valid for complex signals. K2 and K3 have a single positive spectral value; K1 is vacuous. On P3 reflection splits the two nonconstant modes. Their mixed term changes sign between the endpoints and vanishes in the middle. Comparing squared endpoint expressions with mixed coefficients 1/2 and 3/8 gives (7/384)Re(x conjugate(y))² as the exact deficit, including the asserted equality cases. On P4 the reflection-odd restriction of L on (a,b,−b,−a) is [[1,−1],[−1,3]]. Projecting (1,1) onto its two eigenspaces yields coordinatewise products −1/4 and 1/4 and a cross kernel of 1/8. Hence G2² is (5,3,3,5)/16 and its fourth-power norm ratio is 17/256, strictly above 1/16. This verifies both the obstruction and the minimum. value.rationale: Matching the L² coefficient at L⁴ is an exact, natural boundary question.
